review_comments: The original code was passing `isAutoExpandable: getCommandOptions.HasFlag(GetObjectCommandOptions.ForDebuggerProxyAttribute)`, but here we are adding `HasFlag(AutoExpandable)` also. Is that deliberate? If we just want to match the old code then I would keep `isAutoExpandable`, and add `getCommandOptions` to the parameters, so the caller keeps control of when to treat something as autoexpandable.
Oh, sorry, I just saw that `AutoExpandable` is new. Ignore that comment above.
You can add `GetObjectCommandOptions.AutoExpandable` when passing this.
